program.name: Runner Strength 35
program.subject: Running prep
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of runner strength: hips and single legs, or calves, feet and core.
program.about: The strength that keeps runners running. One day trains the hips and single-leg strength, bridges, clamshells and lunges; the other the calves, shins and feet with a runner's core. Straight sets throughout. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II slows every rep down and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Hips & single leg / calves, feet & core, 35 minutes
